candidates.explanation: Board clearly owns orchestration and policy through board-language ports and translating adapters over narrow public server surfaces. Dependencies remain acyclic, the RSC route uses board/rsc.ts, authorization is layered correctly, and unexpected failures have one reporting owner. No negative criterion is violated.

Board clearly owns the cross-capability workflow, with board-shaped ports and private adapters calling public work-items and labels surfaces. It explicitly prevents peer-capability imports and internal imports, routes RSC access through board/rsc.ts, and defines layered authorization plus single-owner failure reporting. The adapters perform translation and enforce boundaries, so they are not policy-free forwarding wrappers.
